result:
The gateway's message to the mastermind now asks it to answer for the voice agent. It leads with the answer, then gives the context the agent needs to hold a conversation (what it is, where it lives, what is open, alternatives, a link or two), in a few short paragraphs at most. The change is merged into `michael/dev`. Like the rest of this work, it goes live only after a Servex restart.

I reran `RemoteMCP.test.mjs` before merging and it passes. I skipped the fresh-eyes review again (`--size none`) because it is one sentence of message text.

The spawn prompt needed no change. It only tells the agent to load the `voice-mastermind` skill, which already says to write for the voice agent. Nothing else in the repo carried the old "easy to hear aloud" wording.
